## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}
Tsisy idiran'ny qualité!

When you take a population, a qualitative variable is a characteristic that is discrete in nature.
In other words, they are not numbers where you can apply operation -- I dare to find a counter-example.
So the best way is can I divided between two, if yes then it is not a qualitative variable.

Why do we need this: well in real world, not everything is a number. Your nationality, your favorite food. but those and so we need a way to distinguish those variables.

the other one when someone collect data is to decide what to record.
Collapsing to qualitative often leads to loss of information.
Your to define such trade-off.
